name: @sunstone-partners/ensemble-router
description: UserPromptSubmit routing hook for intelligent agent delegation and skill invocation

scripts.test: if python3 -c "import importlib.util,sys; sys.exit(0 if importlib.util.find_spec('pytest') else 1)" >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 -m pytest tests/test_router.py -v; elif [ -n "$CI" ]; then echo 'ERROR: pytest is not installed, and CI must not report success on a suite it never ran. The workflow installs it; if that step was removed or reordered, restore it.' >&2; exit 1; else echo 'Skipping Python tests: pytest is not installed for python3. Install it (pip install pytest) to run the router suite.' >&2; fi
